main.description: The complete state of a trmcity procedural city simulation. The tile grid is encoded as one string per row, one character per tile: '~' water, '.' grass, 't' tree, '#' road, and 'a' through 'l' for buildings, where the letter index encodes (level - 1) * 4 + variant for levels 1-3 and variants 0-3. The simulation is deterministic: the rng field carries the pseudo-random generator state between ticks.

tick.description: How many simulation ticks have elapsed since the city was founded.

rows.description: The tile grid, one string per row from north to south, one character per tile from west to east.

rng.description: Saved state of the simulation's pseudo-random generator, as produced by Racket's pseudo-random-generator->vector.

updatedAt.description: When the most recent tick ran.
